children: Stellantis N.V. (MIL:STLAM) faces near-term pressure as Berenberg cuts it to Hold and trims the target to €5.10 amid margin and inventory strains, while the firm weighs selling idle Brampton, issues a 97,349-vehicle U.S. recall, and readies new concepts for Paris 2026.
: Berenberg cut Stellantis (STLAM) to Hold and cut target to €5.10 from €7.80, citing weak North America margins, dealer inventory pressure, raw-material cost risk and unclear margin recovery.
Stellantis In Advanced Talks Sale Roshel
: Stellantis (STLAM) is in advanced talks to sell its idle Brampton assembly plant to Roshel; plant idle since 2024, return to auto production deemed financially unsustainable without the sale.
: Stellantis (STLAM) recalled 97,349 U.S. Chrysler vehicles for detachable roof rack crossbars that can detach and create road hazards, per NHTSA recall identifying the defect and affected units.
: Stellantis (STLAM) will show nine concept cars and 60+ vehicles across eight brands at the Paris Motor Show Oct 12–18, 2026; exhibit highlights FaSTLAne 2030 progress and STLA One platform.
